title: Dolgorae successor Specialist facade v5

x-invariants: Rich structured task context/criterion bounds remain those of facade/v4 and review/v4; no legacy objective fallback. Accepted task_body BytesRef binds complete JCS body.
Exact accepted task_body_schema is https://dolgorae.local/schema/external-specialist-facade/v5#/$defs/task_body; this grammar is distinct from public dolgorae.structured-task/v1.

The supplied task identity is validated against captured complete task bytes before executor acceptance; client preparation does not prove admission. Caller scope is supplied only by trusted transport owner configuration, never model arguments.

Lifecycle lock precedes ledger writer lock. Applying requires explicit operator authority and current-generation dry-run with no live or unknown writer/workload. Protected references and all identity/receipt metadata survive.
plan_ref is known before Apply and equals maintenance operation_ref. Durable original-scope/generation lookup survives generation retirement; unavailable/corrupt state cannot prove not applied.

x-invariants: Not a model tool schema. Authenticated transport binds Controller and scope; caller_scope is protected owner configuration. Opaque binding and Controller secrets remain outside safe records and model arguments.
Explicit regular source inside authorized workspace; no symlinks, escape or source race. Exact JCS group_task_input bytes, at most128MiB, captured before receipt; source path supplies no authority.

x-runtimeAvailability: Unavailable until the corresponding implementing Task passes actual-path qualification. A checked carrier is not runtime admission.
x-toolArguments: Only $defs/public_request is model-visible. trusted_transport_envelope is an authenticated host-to-adapter carrier.
x-unchangedContracts: Accepted facade/v4 requests/results and their existing recovery remain governed by facade/v4.
